  display_value: "standard"
  constancy_format: false
  colour_greater: 5

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
has_kableExtra <- requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_kableExtra) {
  kbl <- kableExtra::kbl
  kable_styling <- kableExtra::kable_styling
  cell_spec <- kableExtra::cell_spec
} else {
  kbl <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, ...)
  kable_styling <- function(x, ...) x
  cell_spec <- function(x, ...) x
}
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg", "Sample_SU", "Sample_Lump", "LayerCode")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_USysAllSpecs.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE lists.USysAllSpecs AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
  dbExecute(con, "ATTACH '../data/vpro_lists.duckdb' AS lists")
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plot_number <- if (is.null(params$plot_number)) "" else as.character(params$plot_number)
plot_numbers <- if (is.null(params$plot_numbers)) "" else as.character(params$plot_numbers)
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(plot_number, plot_numbers)
veg <- load_veg_report_data(
  con,
  plot_numbers = plots,
  site_unit = trimws(params$site_unit),
  project_id = trimws(params$project_id),
  apply_lumping = isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)
)

if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  su <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM Sample_SU")
  if (nrow(su) > 0) {
    names(su) <- tolower(names(su))
    plot_col <- if ("plotnumber" %in% names(su)) "plotnumber" else NULL
    site_col <- if ("siteunit" %in% names(su)) "siteunit" else NULL
    if (!is.null(plot_col) && !is.null(site_col)) {
      su$plotnumber <- as.character(su[[plot_col]])
      su$siteunit <- as.character(su[[site_col]])
      veg <- dplyr::left_join(veg, su[, c("plotnumber", "siteunit")], by = "plotnumber")
    }
  }
}

if (nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit))) {
  veg <- veg[veg$siteunit == trimws(params$site_unit), , drop = FALSE]
}

lifeform_col <- if (!is.null(veg$species_lifeform)) "species_lifeform" else if (!is.null(veg$layer_lifeform)) "layer_lifeform" else NULL

attr_table <- NULL
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "lists.USysSppAttributes")) {
  attr_table <- "lists.USysSppAttributes"
} else if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "USysSppAttributes")) {
  attr_table <- "USysSppAttributes"
}

attr_cols <- character()
if (!is.null(attr_table)) {
  attrs <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s", attr_table))
  names(attrs) <- tolower(names(attrs))
  if ("code" %in% names(attrs)) {
    attrs$species <- as.character(attrs$code)
    veg <- dplyr::left_join(veg, attrs, by = "species")
  }
  attr_cols <- intersect(
    names(veg),
    c("srank", "wetland_ind", "weedstatus", "redbluelist", "est_asmr", "climate")
  )
}

lifeform_codes <- NULL
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "lists.LifeformCodes")) {
  lifeform_codes <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM lists.LifeformCodes")
} else if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "LifeformCodes")) {
  lifeform_codes <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM LifeformCodes")
}

if (!is.null(lifeform_codes)) {
  names(lifeform_codes) <- tolower(names(lifeform_codes))
}

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# `r params$report_title`

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r lifeform-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(lifeform_col) && nrow(veg) > 0) {
  veg$siteunit <- ifelse(is.null(veg$siteunit), "All", veg$siteunit)
  veg$siteunit[is.na(veg$siteunit) | !nzchar(veg$siteunit)] <- "All"

  veg_species <- veg %>%
    dplyr::select(plotnumber, siteunit, species, all_of(lifeform_col), cover_num, present, dplyr::all_of(attr_cols)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(plotnumber, siteunit, species, .keep_all = TRUE)

  plots_by_unit <- veg_species %>%
    dplyr::group_by(siteunit) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_plots = dplyr::n_distinct(plotnumber), .groups = "drop")

  lifeform_plot <- veg %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lifeform_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(siteunit, plotnumber, .data[[lifeform_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(sum_cover = sum(cover_num, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  lifeform_summary <- lifeform_plot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(siteunit, .data[[lifeform_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      plots_with = dplyr::n_distinct(plotnumber),
      sum_cover = sum(sum_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(plots_by_unit, by = "siteunit") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      presence = ifelse(n_plots > 0, plots_with / n_plots, NA_real_),
      mean_cover = ifelse(n_plots > 0, (sum_cover / n_plots) / 100, NA_real_)
    )

  if (!is.null(lifeform_codes)) {
    code_col <- if ("lifeform" %in% names(lifeform_codes)) "lifeform" else names(lifeform_codes)[1]
    label_col <- if ("description" %in% names(lifeform_codes)) "description" else if ("name" %in% names(lifeform_codes)) "name" else if ("label" %in% names(lifeform_codes)) "label" else code_col
    lifeform_codes$lifeform_key <- as.character(lifeform_codes[[code_col]])
    lifeform_codes$lifeform_label <- as.character(lifeform_codes[[label_col]])
  }

  lifeform_summary$lifeform_key <- as.character(lifeform_summary[[lifeform_col]])
  if (is.null(lifeform_codes)) {
    lifeform_summary$lifeform_label <- lifeform_summary$lifeform_key
  }

  units <- unique(veg$siteunit)
  units <- units[order(units)]

  for (unit in units) {
    unit_plots <- plots_by_unit[plots_by_unit$siteunit == unit, , drop = FALSE]
    n_plots <- if (nrow(unit_plots) > 0) unit_plots$n_plots else 0
    unit_species <- veg_species[veg_species$siteunit == unit, , drop = FALSE]
    unique_species <- dplyr::n_distinct(unit_species$species)
    total_occurrences <- nrow(unit_species)

    cat("## Site unit: ", unit, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("- n plots: ", n_plots, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- unique species: ", unique_species, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- total species occurrences: ", total_occurrences, "\n\n", sep = "")

    if (length(attr_cols) > 0) {
      attr_summary <- lapply(attr_cols, function(field) {
        field_vals <- unit_species[[field]]
        list(
          field = field,
          count = sum(!is.na(field_vals) & nzchar(as.character(field_vals))),
          plot_occurrences = dplyr::n_distinct(unit_species$plotnumber[!is.na(field_vals) & nzchar(as.character(field_vals))])
        )
      })
      attr_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(attr_summary, as.data.frame))
      names(attr_summary) <- c("Attribute", "Count", "PlotOccurrences")
      attr_summary$Attribute <- sub("_", " ", attr_summary$Attribute)

      kbl(attr_summary, align = "l") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

      cat("\n\n")
    }

    unit_lifeform <- lifeform_summary[lifeform_summary$siteunit == unit, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!is.null(lifeform_codes)) {
      unit_lifeform <- dplyr::left_join(
        lifeform_codes[, c("lifeform_key", "lifeform_label")],
        unit_lifeform,
        by = "lifeform_key"
      )
    }

    if (nrow(unit_lifeform) > 0) {
      unit_lifeform <- unit_lifeform[unit_lifeform$lifeform_key != "13", , drop = FALSE]
      view <- data.frame(
        Lifeform = unit_lifeform$lifeform_label,
        Presence = round(ifelse(is.na(unit_lifeform$presence), 0, unit_lifeform$presence), 3),
        MeanCover = round(ifelse(is.na(unit_lifeform$mean_cover), 0, unit_lifeform$mean_cover), 3),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      kbl(view, align = "l") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Lifeform field not available in vw_USysAllVeg.")
}
```
